$comment: Second source for block ot-weekdays-01-17 (L-066, 011 amendment 5). OLM 1981 for the readings imported from LitCal (Year II weeks 1-11 and their gospels), in OLM numbering (Nova Vulgata psalms; lectionary:crosscheck converts them, except Ps 115 and 147, whose Nova Vulgata verse numbers equal the Hebrew and are given by hand in `canonical`). LitCal, as printed, for 8-sat, which is filled from OLM 1981 because LitCal's first reading does not parse. LitCal has no data for the other OLM-filled readings (all of Year I; Year II and gospels of weeks 12-17) at the pinned revision in any language (en, fr, hr, it, la, nl); `consulted` records the leaves checked, so those readings are listed as single-source in disputes/ot-weekdays-01-17.md, together with the readings a person should check first. Psalm strophe divisions follow OLM; verse letters are dropped before comparing.
